fact: 1915年1月25日，德国联邦参议院颁布关于面包谷物与面粉流通的条例，宣布国家对全部谷物实行专营；柏林同月起实行面包配给票，每人每周2公斤面包，6月推广到全国。此后大部分食品陆续纳入配给。

sources.title: 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War, Organization of War Economies
sources.quote: On 25 January 1915, Germany instituted a comprehensive state-directed system of supply and distribution of food. The Bundesrat declared a state monopoly on all grains in the country. ... Bread rationing was introduced in Berlin in January 1915 and extended to the rest of the country in June. A ration card for bread allowed two kilograms of bread per person per week.

sources.title: Zwangsbewirtschaftung, 100 Jahre Erster Weltkrieg（引 1915年1月25日联邦参议院条例，RGBl. 1915, S. 35ff.）
sources.quote: Eine tatsächliche und immer umfassendere Zwangsbewirtschaftung wurde erst durch die Verordnung des Bundesrates vom 25. Januar 1915 (RGB, S.35ff.) über die Regelung des Verkehrs mit Brotgetreide und Mehl eingeführt.

fact: 1915年1月25日的谷物条例把全国小麦、黑麦等库存划归柏林的帝国谷物公司管理，私人只可留存不足100公斤的谷物与种子粮；至2月5日，所有谷物持有人必须向地方当局申报并交售存粮，违者或申报不实者处六个月监禁或1500马克罚金。谷物与面粉的自由交易被禁止，面粉由当局指定交付给市政、陆军与海军机关。

sources.title: 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War, Organization of War Economies
sources.quote: It ordered all existing stores of wheat, rye and other cereals to be managed by the Imperial Grain Corporation. Only small amounts of grain less than 100 kilograms and seed grain could remain in private possession. By 5 February 1915, all owners of grain were obligated to declare and surrender their stocks to the local authorities. Anyone who declined or was found guilty of making false and incomplete declarations would be punished by six month imprisonment or a fine of 1,500 marks. ... The free trade of grain and flour was prohibited.

sources.title: Zwangsbewirtschaftung, 100 Jahre Erster Weltkrieg
sources.quote: Alle vorhandenen Getreidevorräte an Weizen und Roggen wurden für die Kriegs-Getreide-Gesellschaft mbH in Berlin beschlagnahmt, also für die Armee. ... Ein direkter Verkauf an Endverbraucher war damit nicht mehr möglich. Die Vorräte mussten in Listen erfasst und den zuständigen Stellen angezeigt werden.

fact: 1915年2月4日，德国宣布对不列颠群岛周边海域实施潜艇封锁，凡驶近英国海岸的船舶（不论交战国或中立国）均视为合法目标；潜艇战实际于2月18日开始。此后数月德国潜艇每月击沉商船逾10万吨，直至1915年秋暂停。

sources.title: Historic UK, World War 1 Timeline – 1915
sources.quote: 4 Feb The Germans declare a submarine blockade of Britain: any ship approaching the British coast is to be considered a legitimate target.

sources.title: Naval History and Heritage Command, Ensuring the Lifeline to Victory
sources.quote: The British again refused, and the German campaign commenced on 18 February. ... the Germans' USW campaign proceeded apace, sinking over 100,000 tons of merchant shipping per month in the period May-August 1915. In the fall of 1915, however, the Germans suspended the campaign after having sent approximately 750,000 tons of shipping to the bottom.

fact: 1915年4月22日，德军在第二次伊普尔战役中首次大规模使用氯气：在两日炮击后，向突出部北侧由法国与阿尔及利亚部队防守的约4英里正面释放168长吨（约171吨）氯气。比空气重的黄绿色气云飘入法军战壕，协约国阵线出现约6公里无人防守的缺口；德军缺乏预备队，未能扩大战果。4月24日德军对加拿大第一师阵地再次施放氯气。

sources.title: Imperial War Museums, Second Battle of Ypres
sources.quote: Gas was not a new weapon in 1915 but the Second Battle of Ypres was the first time chlorine gas was used and the first time it was employed on such a scale. The first gas attack came on 22 April. It targeted a 4-mile stretch of the Allied line on the north side of the salient, held by French and Algerian troops. ... Two days later, on 24 April, a second gas attack targeted the 1st Canadian Division.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Western Front (World War I)
sources.quote: After a two-day bombardment, the Germans released a lethal cloud of 168 long tons (171 t) of chlorine onto the battlefield. ... The green-yellow cloud started killing some defenders and those in the rear fled in panic, creating an undefended 3.7-mile (6 km) gap in the entente line. The Germans were unprepared for the level of their success and lacked sufficient reserves to exploit the opening.

fact: 1915年4月，德国政府下令屠宰约900万头猪，约占全国猪群的三分之一，理由是猪与人争食谷物与土豆。屠宰短期造成猪肉过剩、价格下跌，但随后造成持续到战争结束的肉类短缺；猪粪作为小农肥料来源的损失又反过来压低了作物产量，政策被普遍视为失败。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Schweinemord
sources.quote: In 1915, due to World War I food restrictions and rationing, the German bureaucracy decided to regard pigs as co-eaters with humans and tried to preserve supplies. As a result, five million pigs were massacred in the so-called Schweinemord ... Accordingly, in April 1915, the government ordered that some nine million pigs be slaughtered, despite the protests of farmers who argued that the pigs would be fatter in the autumn. This represented the loss of about one third of the national herd.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica 1922, Germany（EB1922, Vol. 31, p. 302，Wikisource 全文）
sources.quote: A prohibition was issued against feeding cattle with rye or wheat. As it was at first impossible to enforce this prohibition by a system of minute surveillance, an order was issued that one-third of all the swine should be slaughtered.

fact: 1915年5月2日，德奥联军发动戈尔利采—塔尔努夫攻势，突破俄军防线；8月5日德军占领华沙，至8月底德军结束对俄攻势，俄军撤出波兰大部。伊普尔攻势本身被德军设计为掩护向东线调兵的牵制行动。

sources.title: Imperial War Museums, Second Battle of Ypres
sources.quote: The German attack at Ypres was a diversionary action. It concealed the movement of German forces away from the Western Front to Galicia, for the Gorlice-Tarnow Offensive that began in May.

sources.title: Historic UK, World War 1 Timeline – 1915
sources.quote: 5 Aug German troops capture Warsaw from the Russians. ... 31 Aug Having removed Russian forces from much of Poland, Germany ends its offensive against Russia.

fact: 1915年德国面包配给的口粮标准，不同来源记载不一致：一说每人每周2公斤，一说每人每日200克（约合每周1.4公斤）。可以确认的是配给面包须掺入土豆粉等代用物，且1915年内配给范围从面包扩展到大部分食品。

sources.title: 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War, Organization of War Economies
sources.quote: A ration card for bread allowed two kilograms of bread per person per week.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica 1922, Germany（EB1922, Vol. 31, p. 302，Wikisource 全文）
sources.quote: All grain and flour were sequestrated on Feb. i 1915. A system of bread cards was introduced for a ration of 200 grammes of bread per head of the population. It was further decreed that the bread should be baked with an admixture of substances like potato-flour.

fact: 德国在战争期间共发行九次战争公债，全部为长期债：第一次1914年9月、发行价97.5%，募得44.91861亿马克；第二次1915年3月、发行价98.5%，募得91.063947亿马克；第三次1915年9月、发行价99%，募得121.616301亿马克。公债由银行、邮局等渠道向公众推销，主要认购者为机构、企业与市政，而非个人。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica 1922, Germany（EB1922, Vol. 31, p. 303，Wikisource 全文）
sources.quote: Altogether nine war loans were issued. The first (Sept. 1914, issue price 97-5%) produced 4,491,861,000 marks; the second (March 1915, issue price 98-5%) 9,106,394,700; the third (Sept. 1915, issue price 99%) 12,161,630,100 marks

sources.title: Fred Rogers Fairchild, German War Finance—A Review（American Economic Review 12:2, 1922，Internet Archive 全文）
sources.quote: September, 1914 4,460 million marks March, 1915 9,060 ... September, 1915 12,101 ... Total 97,619 million marks

fact: 巴斯夫在奥堡（Oppau）的哈伯—博施合成氨装置1913年投产时年产氨8700吨，到1915年增至约6万吨，为战前七倍。按与德国政府的协议，巴斯夫在半年内完成改造，自1915年5月起每月生产5000吨硝酸钠供军火使用，政府提供600万马克补助；1915年9月起又在法国飞机航程之外筹建规模更大的洛伊纳第二厂。

sources.title: Peter Purbrick, Nitrate traffic（University of Brighton 工作论文）
sources.quote: in 1913 BASF opened an ammonia synthesis plant in Oppau. Initially, it produced 8,700 tons of ammonia for the fertiliser market, but output increased seven times by 1915 to 60,000 tons to meet the demands of industrial warfare; the Haber-Bosch process sustained the German war effort.

sources.title: 澎湃新闻, 德国化工史上最大的一次事故（引巴斯夫厂史与哈伯—博施扩产经过）
sources.quote: 博施和德国政府签订了一项协议，承诺半年内完成奥堡合成氨工厂的改造，自1915年5月起每月生产5千吨硝酸钠。德国政府表示将为巴斯夫的这项计划提供6百万马克的补助金。……1915年9月，德国政府建议巴斯夫在法国飞机炸不到的德国中部地区建一座比现在的合成氨工厂还要大一倍的第二合成氨工厂。
